title: Parity log-concavity conjecture for type B q-Stirling coefficients
statement: For each pair of nonnegative integers $n$ and $k$, let $S_B[n,k]$ and $c_B[n,k]$ be the type $B$ $q$-Stirling polynomials. A coefficient sequence is parity log-concave when its even-indexed and odd-indexed subsequences are each log-concave. **Parity log-concavity conjecture.** For each $n,k$, the coefficients of $S_B[n,k]$ and $c_B[n,k]$ are positive and parity log-concave, hence parity unimodal. The claim is motivated by computational evidence after examples showing that ordinary unimodality can fail in type $B$; the source gives no resolution status.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2205.14078

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of May 2022).
source_name: Bruce E. Sagan and Joshua P. Swanson, “q-Stirling numbers in type B”, arXiv:2205.14078 (2022).
